full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short, is that the present petitioners filed Title Suit being no. 144 of 2011 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Jhalokhati for declaration that the power of attorney executed by some of the defendants in favour of the defendant no.1 (the opposite party no. 1) is fraudulent and collusive. The said suit was renumbered as Title Suit no. 96 of 2011 and the some was transferred in the 1st Court of Joint district Judge, Jhalokathi.
